english.title: Failure to declare name / address to constable - firearm
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required under Section 48(2) of the Firearms Act 1968 by a constable to declare to

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

immediately your name and address, failed to give your true name and address
english.legislation: Contrary to section 48(3) of and Schedule 6 to the FirearmsAct 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
person having possession of a firearm
failed to divulge when required by a constable
their name and address

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See also associated offence wordings as follows: H4336, H4374 and H4381.
(ii) Section 48(2) defines the circumstances in which a constable may require a person to give his or her name and address.
